primary_question: Does a one-shot local epistemic perturbation at a naturally observed Jump reorganize downstream CPR-related process dynamics after the experimental mark has left active context?

jump_recurrence.interpretation: Tests whether Jump-like structure regenerates downstream rather than whether a persistent field remains visible.

inherited_inertia.interpretation: Tests whether a local perturbation preserves, deflects, breaks or later reconverges with the natural path.

path_topology.interpretation: Tests reorganization of observed structural paths; no direction is pre-labelled as better.

requires: one-shot intervention branch has exactly one direct experiment-origin exposure
control has zero direct experiment-origin exposures
pair_eligibility.censoring_rule: Preserve censored trajectories. Do not convert unobserved recurrence/recovery/topology to zero or absence.
pair_eligibility.integrity_failure_rule: Hash, envelope, delivery-count, reinjection, binding or same-parent violations are integrity failures, not outcomes.

claim_boundaries: CPR is a process-dynamics taxonomy, not a synonym for task failure.
Disappearance is not the only mechanism-positive result; regeneration, rerouting and reconvergence are also informative.
Terminal correctness cannot erase an observed process-reality deviation.
A one-shot structural contrast is not automatically semantic C/P/R without adjudication.
The first paper does not claim that a full engineering governance framework has been validated.
analysis_freeze_rules: Any future change requires a new contract version.
Old persistent-intervention evidence remains bound to its historical contracts.
No paid provider/evaluator call is authorized by this contract.
